I discovered this over on Reddit, and was wondering if you might use the idea to "red out" ceddit versions of censored pages.

The basic idea is to "View page source", where the censored post contains the code "<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow" />" and the uncensored post doesn't. It's a nice clear way of establishing if the post was removed by the mods.
Detect if a Reddit post has been censored by the mods

That's awesome, was not aware of this trick.

My app uses the API, but there is no reliable way to detect post removals easily. This may be the most direct way yet, but it kinda sort violates the API terms of service so I will probably avoid using it because my janky compliant method works well enough.

It essentially works by comparing the other discussions tab and /api/info?url=theurl results for a submission, this only works if you know the posted url in advance, or if you are looking for removals from he other side.

If there is only one post of a URL to reddit, this approach doesn't work though.

If there are more than 1 post with the same url to reddit, snew/ceddit can already reliably detect removals by checking from each side.

Not as clean as it could be or as I'd like but the logic for this is here:

https://github.com/snew/snew/blob/master/app/routes/subreddit/link.js#L78
